initialGeneration.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE finished original key-art painting for a class in Hollow Wake, a dark fantasy action RPG. Landscape 3:2, 1536x1024. Premium grounded cinematic realism, photorealistic CG with subtle painterly finish, weathered practical materials, wet stone, cold desaturated blue-grey shadows, deep blacks, volumetric fog, dramatic rim lighting, selective warm ember highlights, restrained grain. Match the visual family of a fiery dual-axe berserker, a hooded necromancer with skeletons and a lightning-calling sorcerer; no cartoon or anime. Compose one clear class-defining action and a distinctive silhouette. Place the adult hero at 62-68% from the left, head at about 30-40% image height, three-quarter body visible, large and readable on a phone. LEFT THIRD is dark, atmospheric low-detail negative space for website copy. Keep the face, important hands, weapons and companion within the central safe area, with generous headroom and nothing important at the outer edge. Cinematic environment fills the entire canvas, no studio background. No text, letters, logos, watermark, border, cards, collage, contact sheet or UI. Anatomically coherent hands and weapon grips. Restrained, believable magic rather than an all-over neon glow. 
CLASS: Necromancer. Create a brand-new painting that belongs to this series. An attractive adult Caucasian woman in her late twenties or thirties with pale natural skin, a beautifully defined face, intense grey eyes, and long lustrous raven-black hair moving in the rain. Her hair and face are clearly visible, not hidden by a hood or skull mask. She wears practical fitted weathered black leather and dark engraved armor, a torn charcoal cloak, and subtle bone and tarnished-silver ornaments. She stands on rain-wet steps of a ruined graveyard mausoleum, quietly commanding two skeletal retainers rising behind her through cold blue-grey fog. Pale restrained corpse-green light coils around her open casting hand; the other hand firmly wraps around a separate ebony-and-bone staff. Both human hands have exactly FIVE anatomically coherent digits: one thumb and four fingers. Show clear finger/weapon boundaries and a believable closed staff grip; no fused skin and weapon. The casting hand has five clearly separated natural digits. Beauty with a composed, dangerous, self-possessed expression; elegant dark fantasy, not a pinup. The skeletal attendants are secondary and partially lost in fog. Hero at about 65% across the frame. Her head has generous clear sky above it: uppermost hair starts below 22% of image height, face centered near 36% height, with hands in the middle half of the image. Dark low-detail LEFT THIRD for website text; keep face and hands away from the smoky outer edges. One seamless grounded cinematic scene, no text or logo.
